ZWA-2 Z-Wave stick on a USB extension from Big Boi

Patch panel B · more wall runs (likely)
UDM Pro · 8.6 lb
USW Aggregation · 8× SFP+ · 6.0 lb
USW Flex 2.5G 8 PoE in its 1U keystone mount
Hub shelf (1U): Hue · Lutron · HDHomeRun · ONT
Brush plate · cords from above pass through
Power Distribution Pro · 2U · 8.2 lb
replaces the Tripp Lite Isobar · fed from the UPS
Second server · old 2U Mini-ITX case
225 mm deep · for other uses · hardware TBD
1U open or blank plate (airflow above Big Boi)
Big Boi · JMCD 12S4 · 6U
36–38 lb with 4 HDDs · 48–50 lb with 12 · on rails/shelf
Spare CLV shelf (U10) + 1U headroom
for later
1U open
1U open (heat from the receiver)
Future: Denon AV receiver on a deep shelf
~4U receiver on a 1U shelf · basement AV
UniFi UPS 2U · 30.9 lb
on rear support rails · battery outlets: Big Boi + PDU
USB radios
ZWA-2 is too big for a shelf: top of the rack or
wall-mounted beside it. Both sticks hang off Big Boi
(U12–U17) on USB 2.0 extensions: Zigbee up to the hub
shelf, ZWA-2 up to the top. Re-map both in the HA VM.
Panels sandwich the switch
Patch panel A directly above the Pro Max 16 and B
directly below: every port patches 1U with 6" cables.
UDM Pro under B, so its LAN ports get 6" runs too.
Aggregation under the UDM: SFP+ DACs to the UDM
(adjacent), the Pro Max (3U up) and Big Boi (1.5 m).
Hub shelf, 1U only
Hue, Lutron, HDHomeRun, ONT and the Zigbee dongle,
right under the Flex mount. The tallest box must fit
in about 40 mm (1.6"): check the HDHomeRun and ONT.
Ting ONT: here if it fits, else the spare shelf.
One brush plate, over the PDU Pro
Power cords, DACs and anything else from the gear
above pass through it to the rear, then down to the
PDU (outlet side unconfirmed). The PDU replaces the
Isobar and powers everything but Big Boi and the AVR.
Second server in the old 2U case
For other uses; light, so mid-rack is fine. On the
PDU it's on battery but outside the NUT shutdown:
it hard-stops when the UPS runs flat unless it gets
its own NUT client (UniFi caps NUT at 3 clients).
Big Boi (U12–U17)
Drive bays roughly 23–34" off the floor, depending
on the base and casters. Support it from below
(L-rails or a rated 1U shelf); ears alone aren't
meant to carry ~50 lb. U18 open for airflow.
Spare shelf under Big Boi
CLV shelf at U10 with 1U above it, kept for later.
250 mm deep, 44 lb max: small boxes only.
Future Denon receiver (U3–U7)
Heavy, so it goes low. Typical X-series AVRs are about
4U tall and ~390 mm deep: too deep for a CLV (250
mm), so use a deeper vented shelf, and check rear
room for speaker wire in the 18" rack. Keep U8 open
for its heat. Power it from the wall, not the PDU:
it can draw hundreds of watts and would drain the
UPS. Size from the actual model before buying.
UPS at the very bottom
Densest item (14 kg in 2U). Two battery outlets
used: Big Boi and the PDU Pro. Rear supports if
it has no rails.
